## Session: 2026-06-01 -- Phase 4 Step 6: Stats Tab + P&L + Stripe Paywall

### What changed this session

- **pps/mobile/app/(tabs)/stats.tsx** -- full build: 5 sections (period selector, profit summary card, inventory snapshot, expense log, mileage tracker). Scout tier shows summary + inventory only; expense log and mileage gated behind PaywallModal. Pull-to-refresh. Add Expense inline modal with category pills (supplies/mileage/storage/other). Log Trip shortcut for mileage expenses.
- **pps/mobile/components/ui/PaywallModal.tsx** -- new: shows feature name, one-line value prop, Hustle price (/mo from constant), Upgrade CTA, Maybe Later dismiss. Props: isible, onClose, featureName, requiredTier, onUpgrade.
- **pps/mobile/lib/stats.ts** -- new: etchStatsSummary(period), etchExpenses(), ddExpense(), createCheckoutSession(tier).
- **packages/shared/src/utils/calcPnl.ts** -- new: port from Flippd pnlCalc (L3028). All values from settings (ebayFee, pkgCost, shipCost, mileageRate, taxReservePct -- never hardcoded). Formula: revenue - cogs - fees - packaging - shipping - expenses - mileage. Tax reserve shown informational only (not deducted).
- **packages/shared/src/types/index.ts** -- added PnlSummary (with taxReserve field) and PnlExpense.
- **packages/shared/src/index.ts** -- exported calcPnl.
- **pps/mobile/components/ui/index.ts** -- exported PaywallModal.
- **supabase/functions/claude-proxy/index.ts** -- added stats_summary (pulls sold items + expenses, runs calcPnl server-side), expenses_list, expenses_add handlers.
- **supabase/functions/stripe-checkout/index.ts** -- new: creates Stripe Checkout Session. Price IDs from env vars (STRIPE_PRICE_HUSTLE_MONTHLY etc -- never hardcoded). Returns { url }. Deployed version 1.

### Decisions made this session (do not reverse)

- calcPnl is a pure function in shared -- proxy calls it server-side, not client-side
- Tax reserve is informational (shown as a callout) -- not deducted from netProfit to avoid confusing the seller
- Scout tier: show P&L summary + inventory counts; expense log + mileage gated (PaywallModal)
- Stripe price IDs: STRIPE_PRICE_HUSTLE_MONTHLY env var -- must be set in Supabase secrets before checkout works
- FlatList removed from stats.tsx imports (unused) -- ScrollView + View gap used instead
